replication.note: Every cell-month has a real TERRA_AQUA row and a TERRA_ONLY replica with Aqua signals masked and the same target. Rows are not independent cell-months; metrics are reported per regime.

settings.m2_covariate_shift: disabled (future=None, uniform weights) for all schemes

spatial_block.replication_note: Each cell-month appears once as TERRA_AQUA and once as TERRA_ONLY (Aqua signals masked, same target). Rows are not independent cell-months; metrics are reported per regime.
spatial_block.interval_coverage_90_note: production_backcast_equivalent = M2 point + M3 sigma on MODIS-only rows. It is not the overlap production interval, where observation and bridge are blended.
